# Supernova Zap (Su-Z)

Supernova Zap is the pastel-haired drummer of PostCrush, a pop duo with singer-guitarist Kiwi Lollipop (K-Lo). She is one of the misguided antagonists of *Equestria Girls: Sunset's Backstage Pass* (2019), where the pressure to make a comeback concert perfect leads the pair to trap the festival in a time loop. She is a canonical human character in G4 Equestria Girls; I found no confirmed pony-world counterpart.

[![Su-Z on drums, with K-Lo — Sunset's Backstage Pass, DHX Media / Allspark Animation](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/2020/7/20/1805985/medium.png)](https://twibooru.org/1805985)

- Appearance: pale yellow skin, blue eyes, a lavender bob with aqua and pink streaks, heart-decorated hair bows, pink heart cheek markings, a blue top with a large pink heart, and a glittery pink skirt. K-Lo is the blue-skinned, pink-haired member.
- Name and voice: Supernova Zap and Su-Z are official character names, not fandom inventions, as shown by the [cast listing](https://watch.plex.tv/en-GB/movie/my-little-pony-equestria-girls-sunsets-backstage-pass/credits). She speaks (Mariee Devereux) and sings (Arielle Tuliao; see the [special's cast and production overview](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/My_Little_Pony:_Equestria_Girls_%E2%80%93_Sunset%27s_Backstage_Pass)).
- Other appearances: she reunites with her pink pet dog, Princess Thunder Guts, in the Rarity ending of [Lost and Pound](https://watch.plex.tv/en-GB/show/my-little-pony-equestria-girls-better-together/season/2/episode/26) (Better Together season 2; also a Choose Your Own Ending short). PostCrush is featured in Whitney Ralls's interactive adaptation [Starswirl Do-Over](https://openlibrary.org/books/OL27339781M/My_Little_Pony_Equestria_Girls_Make_Your_Own_Magic), published February 5, 2019, before the television special.

[![PostCrush — CloudDG, original fan illustration; Su-Z on the left](https://art.ngfiles.com/images/951000/951010_clouddg_postcrush.png?f1562375910=)](https://www.newgrounds.com/art/view/clouddg/postcrush)

## Important moments

The following three scenes occur in [Sunset's Backstage Pass](https://tubitv.com/movies/100032494/my-little-pony-equestria-girls-sunset-s-backstage-pass) (2019 standalone TV special, not a numbered Friendship Is Magic episode; exact timestamps unavailable).

- **The backstage revelation:** Su-Z and K-Lo reveal that they have been resetting the festival with the Time Twirler to eliminate mistakes from their reunion performance.
- **The spell is broken:** Sunset destroys the artifact after Pinkie dislodges it from K-Lo's bow, forcing the musicians to confront their fear of an imperfect show.
- **True Original:** Su-Z acknowledges the pressure they put on themselves, and the duo performs with Sunset and Pinkie, rediscovering the fun of making music together.

Research note: the character wiki and IMDb blocked direct page retrieval, so I used accessible corroborating sources. Exact scene timestamps could not be verified.
